title: Inca quipu
alt: A museum object consisting of a main cord with many hanging knotted cords in different colors.
caption: An Inca quipu: structured record-keeping without a modern table or database.
teachingUse: Broadens the genealogy of data by showing that human records can encode categories and quantities in materially different forms.
